---
title: "SGB Input Contract"
---

Semantic Geometry Builder is context for the `gsim` review, not a `gsim` feature. It owns the optional Route A/B/C semantic sidecar used when layer names alone do not preserve terminal plans, interface ownership, and physical-group identity.

## Need

Some layouts need explicit semantic identity before mesh/config lowering. The sidecar should preserve route choice, canonical topology, electrostatic terminal plans, interface ownership, and physical-group ledgers.

## Native `gsim` Upstream/Main

Native `gsim` can build useful Palace geometry from layers and stack data. Its upstream/main model does not carry SGB-style Route A/B/C semantic sidecars or explicit interface ownership ledgers.

## Local / External Delta

SGB lives in [`semantic-geometry-builder/src/semantic_geometry_builder/`](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/semantic-geometry-builder/tree/main/src/semantic_geometry_builder). The local `gsim` branch also has an SGB/XAO adapter path, but that is optional and branch-local, not native upstream behavior.

## Design And Folders

| Area | Path |
| --- | --- |
| SGB package | [`semantic-geometry-builder/src/semantic_geometry_builder/`](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/semantic-geometry-builder/tree/main/src/semantic_geometry_builder) |
| Stack fixtures | [`notebooks/assets/semantic_geometry_builder/`](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/orpen-sc-pdk/tree/main/notebooks/assets/semantic_geometry_builder) |
| Tutorial sources | [`notebooks/src/SGB_Geometry_Tutorials/`](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/orpen-sc-pdk/tree/main/notebooks/src/SGB_Geometry_Tutorials) |

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["GDS + stack JSON"] --> B["SGB route compiler"]
    B --> C["Canonical topology"]
    B --> D["Terminal/interface ledger"]
    D --> E["Optional gsim consumer"]
```
